name: Athenaeus
bio: Athenaeus is one of the epigrammatists whose short poems were gathered in the Greek Anthology. Paton's index of authors records the poet's date as uncertain. Paton's index describes him as a writer of epigrams.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the third volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Book IX: 496).

poems.title: Book IX, 496
poems.author: Athenaeus
poems.text: Hail! ye who are learned in the Stoic lore, ye whose holy pages contain the very best of doctrines, that virtue is the soul’s only good. ‘This is the only doctrine that saves the lives and cities of men. But indulgence of the flesh, an end dear to others, is only approved by one of all Mnemosyne’s daughters.
